reasons: The typed algorithm passes synthetic nonce, full-rename, ordering, candidate-permutation, semantic-contrast, inconsistency, resource, and replay-verifier tests.
Across 4,638 ReClor training, 500 ReClor validation, 7,376 English LogiQA training, and 651 English LogiQA development cases, zero complete records satisfy every projection precondition.
There are therefore no two independent source examples demonstrating useful direct-language coverage, as required for a generic registered method.
Registering an engine operation or capability descriptor now would expand trusted runtime surface without an executable public-source use case and would require forbidden DS/registry/engine changes.

rejectedRelaxations.change: Ignore passage sentences that fail categorical parsing.
rejectedRelaxations.failure: An ignored conditional, exception, ordering rule, or causal claim can reverse which candidate follows; the opaque-premise control requires NO_APPLICABLE_METHOD.
Removing opaque candidates changes uniqueness and can promote a false answer; the partial-candidate control rejects the complete task.

rejectedRelaxations.change: Treat compound neither/nor, and/or, or relational candidates as one atomic predicate.
rejectedRelaxations.failure: This erases conjunction, disjunction, and argument structure, so the returned conflict is not a proof of the source candidate.

rejectedRelaxations.change: Use lexical overlap or answer position when semantic projection fails.
rejectedRelaxations.failure: Full vocabulary renaming and candidate permutation destroy the heuristic while preserving meaning.

rejectedRelaxations.change: Infer a missing conclusion boundary from the expected answer.
rejectedRelaxations.failure: This crosses the oracle boundary and fails when the same visible passage is paired with a different label.

nextGate: Implement typed conditional, relational, cardinality, ordering, and argument-role language projections with their own proof semantics. Re-run visible clustering and require at least two independent complete source cases before reconsidering registration.
